name: Femke de Vries
bio:
Femke de Vries's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a teenage fascination with vehicle dynamics and a knack for data analysis. Initially drawn to engineering, she soon discovered her true calling lay in bridging the gap between technical development and on-track performance. After completing her degree in Automotive Technology at Delft University of Technology, she started as a data analyst for a small racing team, quickly proving her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the drivers.

Her meticulous approach to test planning and her ability to anticipate potential issues have made her a valuable asset to any team. She prides herself on creating a test environment that is both efficient and conducive to pushing the boundaries of performance. Femke's sharp analytical mind and her dedication to continuous improvement set her apart, making her a highly sought-after test driver coordinator in the competitive world of motorsports.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: She has a focused, almost intense gaze that reflects her analytical mind.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workspace.
